system.description:
Make a Quick Attack with -1 to its attack roll and +1 to its base damage. This Skill gains a different additional effect based on its Trigger.

  • Light Trigger: If this Skills Trigger landed your attack gains [Sunder].
  • Heavy Trigger: If this Skills Trigger and attack landed, the target has its Movement reduced by 5 until the end of the current or next Challenger Phase, whichever ends sooner.
  • Grab Trigger: If Skills attack roll was higher than 8 the target becomes [Staggered] and remains grappled after the attack resolves.
